newsitem.title: INDIA: Indian Punjab cotton extend gains on low arrivals.
newsitem.headline: Indian Punjab cotton extend gains on low arrivals.

text.p: Indian Punjab cotton on Friday extended gains while Gujarat varieties were steady on the cotton market, dealers said.
Punjab cotton forged ahead amidst a shortage of ready stock in the absence of fresh arrivals.

In spot deals Punjab saw-ginned rose by 25 rupees at 1,850/1,925 rupees per maund (37.32 kg) while Bengal-deshi rose by 20 rupees at 1,050/1,100 rupees per maund and F-414 rose by 20/30 rupees at 2,080/2,110 rupees per maund. Gujarat cotton held steady at the improved level amid limited activity.
Gujarat Kalyan was quiet at 14,500/15,000 rupees per candy (355.56 kg) while wagad cotton consolidated gains at 13,400 rupees, and Kala-ginned at 12,700 rupees per candy.
